_read_me: The REAL production rules (CHECK constraints, and NOT NULL columns with no default) for every table the Mailchimp code writes. Read 2026-11-26 from Supabase project pcuycyelxxkxahlxdewl, read only. Used by lib/db-rules-check.ts and lib/beta-mailchimp-writes-real-rules.test.ts.

A COPY GOES STALE. After any migration that changes a check or a NOT NULL on these tables, regenerate (read only) and commit. Checks: select c.relname, con.conname, pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) from pg_constraint con join pg_class c on c.oid = con.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and con.contype = 'c' and c.relname in (<tables>) order by 1, 2;  Required: select table_name, column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name in (<tables>) and is_nullable = 'NO' and column_default is null order by table_name, ordinal_position;

leads.name: leads_address_label_note_check
leads.def: CHECK (((address_label IS DISTINCT FROM 'other'::text) OR ((address_label_note IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(address_label_note) <> ''::text))))

leads.name: leads_stage_check
leads.def: CHECK ((stage = ANY (ARRAY['New'::text, 'Attempting'::text, 'Nurturing'::text, 'Request'::text, 'Estimate Sent'::text, 'Job in Progress'::text, 'Final Processing'::text, 'Closed Won'::text, 'Closed Lost'::text])))

locations.name: locations_default_paths_not_partner
locations.def: CHECK ((((default_drip_path IS NULL) OR (default_drip_path !~~ 'partner-%'::text)) AND ((default_move_drip_path IS NULL) OR (default_move_drip_path !~~ 'partner-%'::text))))

mailchimp_review_choices.name: mailchimp_review_choices_check
mailchimp_review_choices.def: CHECK ((((scope = ANY (ARRAY['group'::text, 'person'::text])) AND (choice = ANY (ARRAY['in'::text, 'out'::text]))) OR ((scope = 'phone'::text) AND (choice = ANY (ARRAY['same'::text, 'different'::text])))))

marketing_unsubscribes.name: marketing_unsubscribes_reversal_check
marketing_unsubscribes.def: CHECK ((((reversed_at IS NULL) AND (reversed_by IS NULL) AND (reversal_reason IS NULL)) OR ((reversed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reversed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(reversal_reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))
